# HavokOS M3 edge cases (todo.md HavokOS M3): language corners the
# reference's run_tests.pike table doesn't reach. One case per line,
# <name><TAB><body>, the body escaped as \\ \n \t. The expected results in
# m3_extra.expected.txt are the live Pike driver's own
# (tools/ref_cases.pike -extra); nothing here was hand-predicted.
closure sees later assignment	int x = 1; function f = function() { return x; }; x = 5; return evaluate(f);
closure writes enclosing local	int x = 1; function f = function() { x++; return x; }; evaluate(f); evaluate(f); return x;
functional reads local by reference	int x = 3; function f = (: x * 2 :); x = 4; return evaluate(f);
nested closure capture	int x = 1; function f = function() { return function() { return x + 1; }; }; x = 10; return evaluate(evaluate(f));
closure captures parameter	function mk(int n) { return (: n + $1 :); } @@ return evaluate(mk(10), 5);
closure varargs parameter	function f = function(int a, int *rest...) { return ({ a, rest }); }; return evaluate(f, 1, 2, 3);
varargs function	mixed f(mixed *a...) { return a; } @@ return ({ f(), f(1), f(1, 2) });
missing args are undefined	mixed f(int a, int b) { return ({ undefinedp(a), undefinedp(b) }); } @@ return f(1);
extra args dropped	int f(int a) { return a; } @@ return f(1, 2, 3);
spread call	int f(int a, int b, int c) { return a * 100 + b * 10 + c; } @@ mixed *x = ({ 2, 3 }); return f(1, x...);
spread in array literal	mixed *a = ({ 1, 2 }); return ({ 0, a..., 3 });
nested mapping +=	mapping m = ([ "a": ([ "b": 1 ]) ]); m["a"]["b"] += 5; return m["a"]["b"];
string index assignment	string s = "abc"; s[1] = 'X'; return s;
string in array index assignment	string *a = ({ "abc" }); a[0][0] = 'Z'; return a[0];
pre and post increment on elements	int *a = ({ 1, 2 }); int x = a[0]++; int y = ++a[1]; return ({ x, y, a[0], a[1] });
post decrement local	int i = 5; int j = i--; return ({ i, j, --i });
array range assignment	int *a = ({ 1, 2, 3, 4 }); a[1..2] = ({ 9 }); return a;
string range assignment from end	string s = "hello"; s[<2..] = "LO"; return s;
range clamping	return ({ "abc"[-5..1], "abc"[2..10], "abc"[2..1], ({ 1, 2, 3 })[1..<1] });
switch default in the middle falls through	int r; switch (3) { case 1: r = 1; default: r += 10; case 2: r += 100; break; case 4: r = 4; } return r;
switch no match no default	switch ("z") { case "a": return 1; } return 2;
switch inside loop: continue and break	int t; for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) { switch (i) { case 1: continue; case 3: break; default: t += i; } t += 100; } return t;
switch open ranges	string *r = ({}); foreach (int x in ({ -5, 3, 50 })) { switch (x) { case ..0: r += ({ "neg" }); break; case 10..: r += ({ "big" }); break; default: r += ({ "mid" }); } } return r;
negative case labels	int x = -2; switch (x) { case -2: return "m2"; case 2: return "p2"; } return 0;
nested catch and rethrow	mixed e = catch { catch(error("a\\n")); throw("b"); }; return e;
error in called function is caught	int f() { error("deep\\n"); } @@ return catch(f());
catch keeps the stack below it	int f() { error("x\\n"); } @@ return ({ 1, catch(f()), 2 });
array index out of range	return catch(({ 1 })[5]);
division and modulo	return ({ catch(1/0), catch(1%0), 7 / -2, -7 % 2, 7.0 / 2, -7 / 2 });
foreach index and value over array	int t; foreach (int i, int v in ({ 10, 20 })) t += i * v; return t;
foreach into existing variable	int k; foreach (k in ({ 1, 2, 3 })) ; return k;
foreach over zero	int n; mixed z; foreach (int x in z) n++; return n;
logical operators return operands	return ({ 0 || "a", 1 && "b", 0 && 1, "" || 5 });
comparisons	return ({ "abc" < "abd", 2 < 2.5, 3 == 3.0, ({}) == ({}), "a" + 1.5 });
array set operators	return ({ ({ 1, 2, 3 }) & ({ 2, 3, 4 }), ({ 1, 2 }) | ({ 2, 3 }), ({ 1, 2 }) ^ ({ 2, 3 }), ({ "a", "b" }) * "-" });
string minus and times	return ({ "abcbd" - "b", "ab" * 3 });
mapping minus	mapping m = ([ 1: 2, 3: 4 ]) - ([ 1: 0 ]); return m;
arrays are shared	int *a = ({ 1 }); int *b = a; b[0] = 9; return a[0];
mappings passed by reference	void f(mapping m) { m["x"] = 1; } @@ mapping m = ([]); f(m); return m["x"];
efun scope	return efun::sizeof(({ 1, 2 }));
efun pointer with bound array	function f = (: implode, ({ "a", "b" }) :); return evaluate(f, "+");
local function pointer calls	int add(int a, int b) { return a + b; } @@ function f = (: add :); return ({ evaluate(f, 2, 3), (*f)(4, 5), f(6, 7) });
bound local function pointer	int add(int a, int b) { return a + b; } @@ function f = (: add, 10 :); return ({ f(5), functionp(f) });
functionp kinds	int g() { return 1; } @@ return ({ functionp((: g :)), functionp((: 1 :)), functionp(function() { return 1; }), functionp((: sefun_hello :)), functionp(0) });
dollar expr in nested functional	int x = 2; function f = (: (: $(x) * $1 :) :); x = 3; return evaluate(evaluate(f), 5);
sort_array by direction	return ({ sort_array(({ "b", "a", "c" }), 1), sort_array(({ 3, 1, 2 }), -1) });
map over mapping	return map(([ 1: 2, 3: 4 ]), (: $1 + $2 :));
filter a mapping	return filter(([ 1: 2, 3: 4, 5: 6 ]), (: $1 > 1 && $2 < 6 :));
map with extra args	return map(({ 1, 2 }), (: $1 * $2 :), 10);
map by function name	int dbl(int x) { return x * 2; } @@ return map(({ 1, 2 }), "dbl", this_object());
class member chain	class p { int *xs; } @@ class p v = new(class p, xs: ({ 1, 2 })); v->xs[1] += 5; return v->xs;
class in array	class p { int n; } @@ class p *a = ({ new(class p) }); a[0]->n = 4; a[0]->n++; return a[0]->n;
class sizeof and typeof	class c { int a; string b; } @@ class c v = new(class c); return ({ sizeof(v), typeof(v), v->b });
call_other on an array	return ({ "/test/base_b", "/test/base_a" })->who();
call_other extra args	return call_other("/test/base_a", "who", 1, 2);
call_other name in a variable	string fn = "only_b"; return load_object("/test/base_b")->(fn)();
recursion	int fib(int n) { return n < 2 ? n : fib(n - 1) + fib(n - 2); } @@ return fib(15);
deep recursion	int d(int n) { return n ? d(n - 1) + 1 : 0; } @@ return d(500);
private and static locally and by self call_other	private int p() { return 7; } static int s() { return 8; } @@ return ({ p(), s(), this_object()->p(), this_object()->s() });
prototype then definition	int later(); int first() { return later(); } int later() { return 3; } @@ return first();
prototype never defined	int nothere(); @@ return catch(nothere());
casts	return ({ (int)2.9, (int)-2.9, (float)3, (int)"  12x", (int)"x", (string)1.5, (float)"2.5abc" });
float to string forms	return ({ "" + 0.1, "" + 1e10, "" + 123456.0, "" + 1234567.0, "" + -0.000012345, "" + 100.0, "" + 0.5 });
typeof	class c { int n; } @@ return ({ typeof(0), typeof((: 1 :)), typeof(this_object()), typeof(new(class c)), typeof(1.0) });
compound bit and shift ops	int x = 6; x &= 3; int y = 1; y <<= 4; int z = 7; z %= 4; int w = 10; w ^= 3; int v = 5; v |= 8; int u = 64; u >>= 2; return ({ x, y, z, w, v, u });
string compound	string s = "a"; s += "b"; s += 1; return s;
array compound	int *a = ({ 1 }); a += ({ 2 }); a -= ({ 1 }); return a;
comma in for	int a, b; for (a = 0, b = 10; a < b; a++, b--) ; return ({ a, b });
do while with continue	int i, t; do { i++; if (i == 2) continue; t += i; } while (i < 4); return t;
while with break	int i; while (1) { if (++i > 5) break; } return i;
functions modify globals	int g; void bump() { g += 2; } @@ bump(); bump(); return g;
global initializer calls a function	int base() { return 5; } int g = base() * 2; @@ return g;
global initializer closure	function gf = (: $1 + 1 :); @@ return evaluate(gf, 1);
this_object inside closure	function f = (: this_object() :); return evaluate(f) == this_object();
sefun pointer previous_object	function f = (: sefun_prev :); return evaluate(f) == this_object();
throw a string	return catch(throw("x"));
not operator	return ({ !0, !0.0, !"", !({}), !this_object() });
undefined mapping key	mapping m = ([]); mixed u; m[u] = 5; return ({ m[0], sizeof(m) });
chained assignment	int a, b, c; a = b = c = 4; return a + b + c;
ternary as lvalue base	int *a = ({ 1 }), *b = ({ 2 }); (1 ? a : b)[0] = 9; return ({ a, b });
assignment value	int x; int y = (x = 3) + 1; return ({ x, y });
int float arithmetic	return ({ 1 + 2.5, 3 * 0.5, 10 - 0.25, 2.0 * 3, 1.0 + 1 });
member_array and keys	return ({ member_array("b", ({ "a", "b" })), member_array(9, ({ 1 })), sizeof(keys(([ 1: 2, 3: 4 ]))), sort_array(values(([ 1: 2, 3: 4 ])), 1) });
allocate	return ({ allocate(3), allocate(2, 7) });
explode edge cases	return ({ explode("abc", ""), explode("a,b,", ","), explode(",", ",") });
evaluate a non-function	return evaluate(5);
call a zero function variable	function f; return catch(f(1));
inherited functions via call_other	object o = load_object("/test/child"); return ({ call_other(o, "a_who"), o->get_counter(), o->call_hidden() });
clone with create args	object o = clone_object("/test/child", 3); return o->get_create_args();
empty array is one shared object	return ({ ({}) == ({}), ({ 1 }) == ({ 1 }), ({}) == allocate(0), ({}) == ({}) - ({}), ([]) == ([]) });
non-empty array literals are fresh	mixed *f() { return ({ 1, 2 }); } @@ mixed *a = f(); a[0] = 9; return ({ f(), a, f() == f() });
growing the shared empty array copies it	mixed *f() { return ({}); } @@ mixed *a = f(); a += ({ 1 }); mixed *b = ({ a... }); return ({ f(), a, b, f() == f() });
